This notebook:

- estimates the Callaway & Sant'Anna (2021) model on the switcher-excluded restricted sample (four specifications)

- runs the pre-trends check and the event study, and

- runs three timing checks, which re-estimate the model (a) with the current-year pill instead of its one-year lag, (b) with the one-year lag but an anticipation of one year, and (c) with the one-year lag on the same rows as (a) (like-for-like comparison)

It reads the panels saved by `Data_Process.ipynb`.

Please make sure to run `Data_Process.ipynb` first to generate the necessary input data.

## Libraries & Configurations

```{r}
# Clear the workspace
rm(list = ls())
```

```{r}
# Directories for data and output
DIR_DATA_PROC <- "Data_Processed/"
DIR_OUT       <- "Output/"

# Set to TRUE to print the sample and the did notes of every Callaway & Sant'Anna run
VERBOSE <- FALSE
dir.create(DIR_OUT, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

## Load Data

```{r}
# Load the processed municipality x year panels saved by Data_Process.ipynb
read_panel <- function(name) {
  read.csv(paste0(DIR_DATA_PROC, name, ".csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
    mutate(dom_comuna = factor(dom_comuna))
}

data_age1    <- read_panel("data_age1")
data_age2    <- read_panel("data_age2")
data_age3    <- read_panel("data_age3")
data_age1_cp <- read_panel("data_age1_cp")
data_age2_cp <- read_panel("data_age2_cp")
data_age3_cp <- read_panel("data_age3_cp")
```

```{r}
# Switcher-excluded samples, selected with the indicators in the panels (droplevels() drops the municipalities that are no longer in the sample)
#   _ns:   one-year lagged pill (is_switcher == 0)
#   _cpns: current-year pill
#   _lgns: one-year lagged pill on the same rows as the current-pill data (in_cp == 1)
data_age1_ns   <- data_age1 |> filter(is_switcher == 0) |> droplevels()
data_age2_ns   <- data_age2 |> filter(is_switcher == 0) |> droplevels()
data_age3_ns   <- data_age3 |> filter(is_switcher == 0) |> droplevels()

data_age1_cpns <- data_age1_cp |> filter(is_switcher == 0) |> droplevels()
data_age2_cpns <- data_age2_cp |> filter(is_switcher == 0) |> droplevels()
data_age3_cpns <- data_age3_cp |> filter(is_switcher == 0) |> droplevels()

data_age1_lgns <- data_age1 |> filter(in_cp == 1, is_switcher == 0) |> droplevels()
data_age2_lgns <- data_age2 |> filter(in_cp == 1, is_switcher == 0) |> droplevels()
data_age3_lgns <- data_age3 |> filter(in_cp == 1, is_switcher == 0) |> droplevels()

# Check the sizes of the switcher-excluded samples
samples <- list(
  `lagged pill`                = list(data_age1_ns, data_age2_ns, data_age3_ns),
  `current pill`               = list(data_age1_cpns, data_age2_cpns, data_age3_cpns),
  `lagged pill, same rows`     = list(data_age1_lgns, data_age2_lgns, data_age3_lgns)
)
sample_sizes <- imap_dfr(samples, \(dfs, nm) tibble(
  sample      = nm,
  age_group   = c("all_women", "teens", "young_adult"),
  n_municipal = map_int(dfs, \(x) n_distinct(x$dom_comuna)),
  n_obs       = map_int(dfs, nrow)
))
cat("\n===== Sample sizes (municipalities and municipality-years) =====\n")
sample_sizes
```

## Callaway & Sant'Anna (2021) Estimation

### (1) Stage 2 Task 1: Callaway & Sant'Anna (2021) Estimation

```{r}
# Function to prepare the switcher-excluded panel for Callaway & Sant'Anna (2021)
prepare_cs_data <- function(panel, outcome, trend_years = 2006:2009, label = "") {

  # Municipalities first treated after the last year of the panel are not treated within the sample, so they are comparison units
  panel <- panel |>
    mutate(first_treat = ifelse(first_treat > max(year), 0, first_treat))

  n_munis <- n_distinct(panel$dom_comuna)

  # Municipality-specific linear trend, fitted on the pre-treatment years
  trend_fit <- panel |>
    filter(year %in% trend_years, is.finite(.data[[outcome]])) |>
    group_by(dom_comuna) |>
    filter(n() >= 3) |>
    summarise(
      slope     = cov(year, .data[[outcome]]) / var(year),
      intercept = mean(.data[[outcome]]) - slope * mean(year),
      .groups   = "drop"
    )

  # Covariates at their 2008 values
  x_cols <- grep("^X_", names(panel), value = TRUE)
  base   <- panel |>
    filter(year == 2008) |>
    distinct(dom_comuna, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    select(dom_comuna, all_of(x_cols))

  x_keep <- x_cols[vapply(x_cols, function(v) {
    if (startsWith(v, "X_party_")) sum(base[[v]], na.rm = TRUE) >= 10 else var(base[[v]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  }, logical(1))]
  x_keep <- setdiff(x_keep, grep("^X_party_", x_keep, value = TRUE)[1])   # Drop the reference party dummy

  base <- base |>
    select(dom_comuna, all_of(x_keep)) |>
    rename_with(~ sub("^X_", "B_", .x), all_of(x_keep))

  # Report what is dropped: no fitted trend, no 2008 covariates, covariates left out
  if (VERBOSE) cat(glue("[{label}] municipalities: {n_munis}; without a fitted trend: {n_munis - nrow(trend_fit)}; without 2008 covariates: {n_munis - sum(complete.cases(base))}; covariates left out: {paste(setdiff(x_cols, x_keep), collapse = ', ')}"), "\n", sep = "")

  # Add the three sets of variables to the panel
  result <- panel |>
    left_join(trend_fit, by = "dom_comuna") |>
    mutate(
      id_num = as.integer(factor(dom_comuna)),
      "{outcome}_dt" := .data[[outcome]] - (intercept + slope * year)
    ) |>
    select(-slope, -intercept) |>
    left_join(base, by = "dom_comuna")

  return(result)
}
```

```{r}
# Function to run the Callaway & Sant'Anna (2021) estimator for one specification 
run_cs <- function(panel, outcome, age_group, spec, base_period = "varying", anticipation = 0) {

  # Outcome, covariates and weights of the specification
  y_name  <- if (spec == "with_trends") paste0(outcome, "_dt") else outcome
  xformla <- if (spec == "with_covariates") as.formula(paste("~", paste(grep("^B_", names(panel), value = TRUE), collapse = " + "))) else ~1
  weights <- if (spec == "popln_weighted") "popln" else NULL

  # Set the random seed for reproducibility of the bootstrap procedure
  set.seed(2727)

  # Estimate ATT(g,t) with never-treated municipalities as the comparison group
  did_notes <- character()
  invisible(capture.output(
    att_gt_est <- withCallingHandlers(
      att_gt(
        yname                  = y_name,
        tname                  = "year",
        idname                 = "id_num",
        gname                  = "first_treat",
        xformla                = xformla,
        data                   = as.data.frame(panel),
        control_group          = "nevertreated",
        weightsname            = weights,
        fix_weights            = if (is.null(weights)) NULL else "varying",   # Use each year's own weights, whether or not the panel is balanced
        allow_unbalanced_panel = TRUE,
        clustervars            = "id_num",
        bstrap                 = TRUE,
        biters                 = 1000,
        base_period            = base_period,
        anticipation           = anticipation
      ),
      warning = function(w) { did_notes <<- c(did_notes, conditionMessage(w)); invokeRestart("muffleWarning") },
      message = function(m) { did_notes <<- c(did_notes, trimws(conditionMessage(m))); invokeRestart("muffleMessage") }
    )
  ))

  # Observations and cohorts actually used by att_gt
  used       <- att_gt_est$DIDparams$data
  cohorts    <- used |> distinct(id_num, first_treat) |> count(first_treat)
  cohort_txt <- paste0(cohorts$first_treat, " (", cohorts$n, ")", collapse = ", ")
  if (VERBOSE) cat(glue("[{age_group} / {outcome} / {spec}] municipalities: {att_gt_est$n}, observations: {nrow(used)}, cohorts (Inf = never treated): {cohort_txt}"), "\n", sep = "")
  did_notes <- did_notes[!grepl("^Time-varying weights detected", did_notes)]   # Handled by fix_weights above
  if (VERBOSE && length(did_notes) > 0) cat(glue("  did notes: {paste(unique(did_notes), collapse = ' | ')}"), "\n", sep = "")

  # ATT(g,t) cells that could not be estimated 
  n_att_na <- sum(is.na(att_gt_est$att))
  if (n_att_na > 0) {
    cat(glue("[{age_group} / {outcome} / {spec}] {n_att_na} ATT(g,t) cells could not be estimated and are dropped from the aggregation\n\n"))
  }

  # Overall effect theta_sel^o: the average of the cohort-level effects theta_sel(g), weighted by cohort size
  overall_agg <- withCallingHandlers(
    aggte(att_gt_est, type = "group", na.rm = TRUE),
    warning = function(w) if (grepl("simultaneous confidence band", conditionMessage(w))) invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
  )

  # Dynamic effects theta_ES(e), used for the pre-trends check and the event study
  dynamic_agg <- aggte(att_gt_est, type = "dynamic", na.rm = TRUE)

  # Summary row of the overall effect, with a p-value from a normal approximation
  overall <- tibble(
    age_group   = age_group,
    outcome     = outcome,
    spec        = spec,
    coef        = overall_agg$overall.att,
    se          = overall_agg$overall.se,
    p_value     = 2 * pnorm(-abs(overall_agg$overall.att / overall_agg$overall.se)),
    n_obs       = nrow(used),                    # Municipality-year observations used by att_gt
    n_municipal = att_gt_est$n,                  # Municipalities actually used by att_gt (unbalanced-panel aware)
    n_att_na    = n_att_na,
    has_covariates = (spec == "with_covariates") # Whether the specification conditions on the baseline covariates
  )

  result <- list(dynamic = dynamic_agg, overall = overall)

  return(result)
}
```

```{r}
# Function to run the four CS specifications for one age group and one outcome, mirroring the four TWFE specifications
run_cs_specs <- function(panel, outcome, age_group, trend_years = 2006:2009, anticipation = 0) {

  panel_cs <- prepare_cs_data(panel, outcome, trend_years, label = glue("{age_group} / {outcome}"))

  result <- list(
    baseline        = run_cs(panel_cs, outcome, age_group, "baseline",        anticipation = anticipation),
    with_trends     = run_cs(panel_cs, outcome, age_group, "with_trends",     anticipation = anticipation),
    with_covariates = run_cs(panel_cs, outcome, age_group, "with_covariates", anticipation = anticipation),
    popln_weighted  = run_cs(panel_cs, outcome, age_group, "popln_weighted",  anticipation = anticipation)
  )

  return(result)
}
```

```{r}
# Run the four Callaway & Sant'Anna specifications for all 3 age groups and 2 outcomes
cs_11 <- run_cs_specs(data_age1_ns, "birth_rate", "all_women")
cs_12 <- run_cs_specs(data_age1_ns, "death_rate", "all_women")
cs_21 <- run_cs_specs(data_age2_ns, "birth_rate", "teens")
cs_22 <- run_cs_specs(data_age2_ns, "death_rate", "teens")
cs_31 <- run_cs_specs(data_age3_ns, "birth_rate", "young_adult")
cs_32 <- run_cs_specs(data_age3_ns, "death_rate", "young_adult")

cs_all <- list(cs_11, cs_12, cs_21, cs_22, cs_31, cs_32)

results_s2t1_cs <- map(cs_all, \(cs) map(cs, "overall") |> bind_rows()) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  arrange(factor(spec, levels = c("baseline", "with_trends", "with_covariates", "popln_weighted")))

write.csv(results_s2t1_cs, paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s2t1_cs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n===== Stage 2 Task 1: Callaway & Sant'Anna (2021) Estimates (4 Specifications, 6 Groups) =====\n")
results_s2t1_cs
```

### (2) Stage 2 Task 2: Pre-treatment Dynamic Effects

#### (a) Pre-trends Table

```{r}
# Function to extract the pre-treatment (e<0) dynamic effects of one CS run, as a "placebo-style" pre-trends check
extract_pretrends <- function(cs_obj) {

  d <- cs_obj$dynamic

  result <- tibble(
      age_group  = cs_obj$overall$age_group,
      outcome    = cs_obj$overall$outcome,
      event_time = d$egt,
      att        = d$att.egt,
      se         = d$se.egt,
      crit_val   = d$crit.val.egt
    ) |>
    filter(event_time < 0) |>
    mutate(
      # Pointwise p-value from a normal approximation, and significance under the uniform critical value
      p_value     = 2 * pnorm(-abs(att / se)),
      sig_at_5pct = abs(att / se) > crit_val,
      # Same N as the overall ATT for this age group/outcome (same underlying att_gt object)
      n_obs       = cs_obj$overall$n_obs,
      n_municipal = cs_obj$overall$n_municipal
    )

  return(result)
}

# Function to apply an extraction function to the six groups of a list of CS runs, for one specification, and stack the results
stack_results <- function(runs, spec, extract) {

  result <- runs |>
    map(\(run) extract(run[[spec]])) |>
    bind_rows()

  return(result)
}
```

```{r}
# Pre-trends of the Full Model (main)
results_s2t2_pretrends <- stack_results(cs_all, "with_covariates", extract_pretrends)

write.csv(results_s2t2_pretrends, paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s2t2_pretrends.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Pre-trends of the other specifications. The "with_trends" specification is left out
results_s2t2_pretrends_allspecs <- bind_rows(
  baseline        = stack_results(cs_all, "baseline",        extract_pretrends),
  with_covariates = stack_results(cs_all, "with_covariates", extract_pretrends),
  popln_weighted  = stack_results(cs_all, "popln_weighted",  extract_pretrends),
  .id = "spec"
) |>
  relocate(spec, .after = outcome)

write.csv(results_s2t2_pretrends_allspecs, paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s2t2_pretrends_allspecs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n===== Stage 2 Task 2: Pre-treatment Dynamic Effects (Placebo-style Pre-trends Check) =====\n")
results_s2t2_pretrends
```

#### (b) Event Study

```{r}
# Function to run the baseline and Full Model CS with the universal base period (every year compared with e = -1)
run_cs_es <- function(panel, outcome, age_group) {

  panel_cs <- prepare_cs_data(panel, outcome, label = glue("{age_group} / {outcome}, event study"))

  result <- list(
    baseline        = run_cs(panel_cs, outcome, age_group, "baseline",        base_period = "universal"),
    with_covariates = run_cs(panel_cs, outcome, age_group, "with_covariates", base_period = "universal")
  )

  return(result)
}

# Function to extract the event-study estimates (e >= -4) of one CS run, with uniform confidence bands
extract_event_study <- function(cs_obj) {

  d <- cs_obj$dynamic

  result <- tibble(
      age_group  = cs_obj$overall$age_group,
      outcome    = cs_obj$overall$outcome,
      event_time = d$egt,
      att        = d$att.egt,
      se         = d$se.egt,
      crit_val   = d$crit.val.egt
    ) |>
    filter(event_time >= -4) |>
    mutate(
      # The reference period (e = -1) is normalised to zero and has no standard error
      se       = if_else(is.na(se), 0, se),
      # Uniform (simultaneous) confidence band, consistent with the critical value used in the pre-trends table
      ci_lower = att - crit_val * se,
      ci_upper = att + crit_val * se
    )

  return(result)
}

# Event study on the switcher-excluded restricted sample for all 3 age groups and both outcomes
es_11 <- run_cs_es(data_age1_ns, "birth_rate", "all_women")
es_12 <- run_cs_es(data_age1_ns, "death_rate", "all_women")
es_21 <- run_cs_es(data_age2_ns, "birth_rate", "teens")
es_22 <- run_cs_es(data_age2_ns, "death_rate", "teens")
es_31 <- run_cs_es(data_age3_ns, "birth_rate", "young_adult")
es_32 <- run_cs_es(data_age3_ns, "death_rate", "young_adult")

es_all <- list(es_11, es_12, es_21, es_22, es_31, es_32)

# Full Model (main) and baseline (kept for reference)
results_s2t2_eventstudy          <- stack_results(es_all, "with_covariates", extract_event_study)
results_s2t2_eventstudy_baseline <- stack_results(es_all, "baseline",        extract_event_study)

write.csv(results_s2t2_eventstudy,          paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s2t2_eventstudy.csv"),          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(results_s2t2_eventstudy_baseline, paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s2t2_eventstudy_baseline.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n===== Stage 2 Task 2: Event-Study Estimates (Universal Base Period, 6 Groups) =====\n")
results_s2t2_eventstudy
```

```{r}
# Rows: age groups; columns: outcomes
fig_eventstudy <- results_s2t2_eventstudy |>
  mutate(
    age_group = factor(
      age_group,
      levels = c("all_women", "teens", "young_adult"),
      labels = c("All women (15-49)", "Teens (15-19)", "Young adults (20-34)")
    ),
    outcome   = factor(
      outcome,
      levels = c("birth_rate", "death_rate"),
      labels = c("Birth rate (per 1,000 women)", "Foetal death rate (per 1,000 births)")
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = event_time, y = att)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, colour = "grey75") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), size = 0.4) +
  facet_grid(age_group ~ outcome, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = -4:1) +
  labs(x = "Years relative to the first outcome year (e)", y = "ATT estimate") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    # Separate the two columns clearly so that the birth-rate and death-rate panels are not read as one plot
    panel.spacing.x = unit(2.5, "lines"),
    panel.border    = element_rect(colour = "grey60", fill = NA)
  )

ggsave(paste0(DIR_OUT, "figure_s2t2_eventstudy.png"), fig_eventstudy, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

fig_eventstudy
```

### (3) Stage 2 Task 3: Timing Checks

#### (a) Callaway & Sant'Anna (2021) with the Current-Year Pill

```{r}

cs_cp_12 <- run_cs_specs(data_age1_cpns, "death_rate", "all_women",   trend_years = 2006:2008)

cs_cp_22 <- run_cs_specs(data_age2_cpns, "death_rate", "teens",       trend_years = 2006:2008)
cs_cp_31 <- run_cs_specs(data_age3_cpns, "birth_rate", "young_adult", trend_years = 2006:2008)
cs_cp_32 <- run_cs_specs(data_age3_cpns, "death_rate", "young_adult", trend_years = 2006:2008)

results_s2t3a_cs_cp <- map(cs_cp_all, \(cs) map(cs, "overall") |> bind_rows()) |>
  bind_rows() |>

write.csv(results_s2t3a_cs_cp, paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s2t3a_cs_cp.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

results_s2t3a_cs_cp
```

```{r}
# Event study with the base year moved back to e = -2 (anticipation = 1, universal base period)
run_cs_es_ant <- function(panel, outcome, age_group) {
  panel_cs <- prepare_cs_data(panel, outcome, label = glue("{age_group} / {outcome}, anticipation event study"))
  list(with_covariates = run_cs(panel_cs, outcome, age_group, "with_covariates", base_period = "universal", anticipation = 1))
}

# Same as extract_event_study(), but keeps e = -5 as well
extract_event_study_ant <- function(cs_obj) {
  d <- cs_obj$dynamic
  tibble(
      age_group  = cs_obj$overall$age_group,
      outcome    = cs_obj$overall$outcome,
      event_time = d$egt,
      att        = d$att.egt,
      se         = d$se.egt,
      crit_val   = d$crit.val.egt
    ) |>
    filter(event_time >= -5) |>
    mutate(
      se       = if_else(is.na(se), 0, se),
      ci_lower = att - crit_val * se,
      ci_upper = att + crit_val * se
    )
}

es_ant_all <- list(
  run_cs_es_ant(data_age1_ns, "birth_rate", "all_women"),
  run_cs_es_ant(data_age1_ns, "death_rate", "all_women"),
  run_cs_es_ant(data_age2_ns, "birth_rate", "teens"),
  run_cs_es_ant(data_age2_ns, "death_rate", "teens"),
  run_cs_es_ant(data_age3_ns, "birth_rate", "young_adult"),
  run_cs_es_ant(data_age3_ns, "death_rate", "young_adult")
)

results_s2t2_eventstudy_ant <- stack_results(es_ant_all, "with_covariates", extract_event_study_ant)
write.csv(results_s2t2_eventstudy_ant, paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s2t2_eventstudy_ant.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

fig_eventstudy_ant <- results_s2t2_eventstudy_ant |>
  mutate(
    age_group = factor(age_group, levels = c("all_women", "teens", "young_adult"),
                       labels = c("All women (15-49)", "Teens (15-19)", "Young adults (20-34)")),
    outcome   = factor(outcome, levels = c("birth_rate", "death_rate"),
                       labels = c("Birth rate (per 1,000 women)", "Foetal death rate (per 1,000 births)"))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = event_time, y = att)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -1.5, colour = "grey75") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), size = 0.4) +
  facet_grid(age_group ~ outcome, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = -5:1) +
  labs(x = "Years relative to the first outcome year (e)", y = "ATT estimate") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.spacing.x = unit(2.5, "lines"), panel.border = element_rect(colour = "grey60", fill = NA))

ggsave(paste0(DIR_OUT, "figure_s2t2_eventstudy_ant.png"), fig_eventstudy_ant, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
fig_eventstudy_ant
```

#### (b) Callaway & Sant'Anna (2021) with Anticipation of One Year

```{r}
# Run the four Callaway & Sant'Anna specifications with anticipation = 1 for all 3 age groups and 2 outcomes, trends fitted on 2006-2008
cs_ant_11 <- run_cs_specs(data_age1_ns, "birth_rate", "all_women",   trend_years = 2006:2008, anticipation = 1)
cs_ant_12 <- run_cs_specs(data_age1_ns, "death_rate", "all_women",   trend_years = 2006:2008, anticipation = 1)
cs_ant_21 <- run_cs_specs(data_age2_ns, "birth_rate", "teens",       trend_years = 2006:2008, anticipation = 1)
cs_ant_22 <- run_cs_specs(data_age2_ns, "death_rate", "teens",       trend_years = 2006:2008, anticipation = 1)
cs_ant_31 <- run_cs_specs(data_age3_ns, "birth_rate", "young_adult", trend_years = 2006:2008, anticipation = 1)
cs_ant_32 <- run_cs_specs(data_age3_ns, "death_rate", "young_adult", trend_years = 2006:2008, anticipation = 1)

cs_ant_all <- list(cs_ant_11, cs_ant_12, cs_ant_21, cs_ant_22, cs_ant_31, cs_ant_32)

results_s2t3b_cs_ant <- map(cs_ant_all, \(cs) map(cs, "overall") |> bind_rows()) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  arrange(factor(spec, levels = c("baseline", "with_trends", "with_covariates", "popln_weighted")))

write.csv(results_s2t3b_cs_ant, paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s2t3b_cs_ant.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n===== Stage 2 Task 3b: Callaway & Sant'Anna (2021) Estimates with Anticipation = 1 (4 Specifications, 6 Groups) =====\n")
results_s2t3b_cs_ant
```
